infographic.title: How an RTD Measures Temperature
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how an RTD Pt100 sensor converts temperature into a resistance and a 4 to 20 mA signal
steps: Process heat passes through the thermowell and sheath to the platinum element.
Platinum resistance rises about 0.385 ohm per degree Celsius for a Pt100.
The transmitter passes a tiny current and measures the voltage across the element.
Resistance is converted to temperature and sent as 4 to 20 mA or HART.
